_comment: Bounded SemRisk asserted-source adapter; WebVOWL 1.1.7 renderer, not OWL2VOWL conversion or full OWL semantics.

comment.en: A contextual, time-bound information/measurement result produced by a Risk Assessment Activity concerning a risk subject/context.

A concrete responsibility/accountability assignment context that depends on an Actor/role bearer and any modeled governance participants, and is about the Risk, artifact, plan or obligation it concerns.
Responsibility asserted with explicit evidence of at least two distinct endurant participants; additional closed-world requirements are in the separate shape graph.

An issued, immutable numeric-scale specification version defining interval bounds and an assessment dimension. Identity is inherited from ArtifactVersion; abstract interval content and equal numeric bounds do not determine artifact identity. Not a universal risk scoring scale.
Opt-in operational profile for numeric results with explicit method, scale and temporal context; not a new risk identity.
An immutable issued information artifact version; a new content-bearing revision receives a new version IRI. Equal content does not identify two issuing acts or versions.

description.en: Only explicit named class hierarchy and properties with unique asserted endpoints are graphed. All 116 declarations and omitted semantics are available in the formal index.
